overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that changing the default from `= []` to `Field(default=[])` would preserve the same runtime behavior when the model is constructed without explicitly passing `workers`, but it overlooked that pydantic's `defer_build` mechanism means the class attribute `workers` is not materialized as a real list on the instance until the model is first used, and the `Field` wrapper interacts with that deferral differently than a plain class attribute default.
why_it_breaks: When `DEFER_PYDANTIC_BUILD` is true (the default), pydantic defers schema construction. A plain class attribute default `= []` creates the list at class definition time, but `Field(default=[])` defers the creation and may leave the attribute inaccessible as a real `list` object until the model is first serialized or accessed under the deferred build protocol. The error `'CredentialLiteLLMParams' object has no attribute 'use_litellm_proxy'` indicates that during the first concurrent request on a fresh worker, the model's internal deferred build process fails to materialize the `workers` attribute, causing missing internal fields. Later requests succeed because the class has already been built. The agent's change from `= []` to `Field(default=[])` was intended to satisfy ruff RUF012 but broke the deferred build contract for this model.
